errors.text: The cited evidence supports Ga-associated changes in FCC/BCC phase fractions and possibly remanence, but does not establish an increase in coercive field or the proposed magnetic-anisotropy mechanism.
The stated condition of 'no external magnetic field' is incompatible with measuring coercive field, which requires a swept applied-field hysteresis measurement.

The hypothesis does not reconstruct the target intervention or mediator: it substitutes Ga-induced FCC-to-BCC transformation in a different alloy for rapid-quench stabilization of an fcc/C14 dual-phase FeCoNiTi microstructure.
